author: startuphours
text:
@polariscampus is where young minds are turning ideas into real-world innovations! 

A 19-year-old student is building an AI companion for women’s health! 

Meet Raj, a second-year student at Polaris School of Technology, Bengaluru, who built MOMPULSE, an AI-powered app designed to support women through periods, pregnancy and motherhood.

From tracking periods and answering pregnancy-related questions to offering baby care guidance, MomPulse aims to provide personalised support at every stage of a woman’s journey. 

What makes it interesting? Its dashboard adapts to different life stages, bringing relevant information and guidance into one place.

Raj is building MomPulse while pursuing his studies, showing how young students are turning real-world problems into technology-driven solutions.

Polaris School of Technology is a new-age tech college focused on helping students build businesses and pursue global internships while earning from their first year.

@polariscampus students are building technology that could help save lives. 

Meet Aditya Chauhan and Harsh Saini, 2nd-year students behind SafeAround, a women’s safety app designed to identify potentially risky areas before you reach them.

With risk-level indicators, safer route planning, and an SOS feature that alerts people nearby, they’re using technology to make everyday journeys safer.

And the crazy part?
